prompt: When someone submits our Typeform contact form, create the lead in Pipedrive as organization, person and deal.

plan.summary: When a Typeform contact form is submitted, create an organization, a person, and a deal in Pipedrive linked to that person.

source.docsQuery: Typeform API webhook form response submitted fields

target.docsQuery: Pipedrive API create organization create person create deal endpoints

fieldMapping.note: Typeform 'name' field maps to Pipedrive organization title
Typeform 'email' field maps to Pipedrive person email
Typeform 'phone' field maps to Pipedrive person phone
Typeform 'company' field maps to Pipedrive organization title
Typeform 'name' field maps to Pipedrive person name
Typeform form title or a fixed value used as deal name

assumptions: The Typeform webhook payload includes fields for name, email, phone, and company.
Pipedrive API requires separate calls to create an organization, then a person linked to that organization, then a deal linked to that person.
The user has valid Pipedrive API credentials with permissions to create organizations, persons, and deals.

sources.title: Pipedrive API v1–v2 Dev References (Organizations) - Learn - Test - Try Now
Pipedrive API v1–v2 Dev References (Deals) - View id Deals Query Params

fields.title: Please give us your email address.

notes: Typeform sends webhook payloads via POST requests with JSON body.
Answers are in an array; each answer object includes a 'type' and a value field (e.g., 'text', 'email') and a 'field' object with 'id' and 'type'.
To extract values, match answer.field.id with definition.fields[i].id where the title corresponds to the expected question (name, email, phone, company).
Form title is available in form_response.definition.title.
No authentication is required on the webhook endpoint; security relies on HTTPS and optional secret (not covered in docs).
Endpoint creates a new organization. Requires 'name' field.
Authentication via Bearer token in Authorization header.
Response includes organization ID needed to link person.
API version is v2; cost is 10 per call.
Endpoint creates a new person. Requires 'name'.
Email and phone are arrays of objects with 'value' and 'primary' flags.
organization_id links the person to the previously created organization.
Response includes person ID needed to link deal.
API version is v2; cost is 10 per call.
Endpoint creates a new deal. Requires 'title', 'person_id', 'value', and 'status'.
person_id links the deal to the previously created person.
value is required (can be 0 if unknown); status defaults to 'open' but explicit is safer.
Response includes deal ID for confirmation.
API version is v2; cost is 10 per call.
